feed_material_class: clarified or pumpable grass/leaf protein concentrate
feed_solids_policy: direct upstream value; plant-protein range only for sensitivity
process_condition_policy: select inlet/outlet pair from pilot trials; do not use inlet temperature as particle temperature
quality_priority: solubility, native protein retention, moisture, bulk density and recovery
energy_model: air heating + evaporation + blower + atomizer + collection losses
equipment_scope: feed system, atomizer, chamber, air heater, blower, cyclone/filter, controls
cost_policy: vendor or validated equipment correlation only
proxy_policy: legume/yam data allowed as clearly marked plant-protein proxies
milk_powder_policy: not accepted as direct flux, heat, density, stickiness or recovery data
required_direct_inputs: feed rheology/solids, droplet PSD, air flow, residence time, moisture, recovery, wall loss, quality, heat and power
validation_targets: mass balance; moisture; powder yield; particle PSD; solubility and DSC/functional retention
data_completeness: medium for equations, low for grass-specific observations
warnings: Grass pigments, minerals, carbohydrates and lipids can alter stickiness, oxidation and thermal response.

process_condition_policy: lower outlet temperature with sufficient dry-air flow; validate residual moisture and deposition
energy_model: same as base; potentially greater air demand or lower throughput
proxy_policy: plant-protein operating envelope for sensitivity only
required_direct_inputs: stickiness/glass transition, outlet moisture, wall loss, quality response
validation_targets: acceptable moisture without excessive wall deposition
warnings: Lower temperature does not guarantee better product if residence time, moisture or oxidation increase.

feed_material_class: tray- or vial-filled grass protein concentrate/paste
process_condition_policy: cycle developed from DSC, freeze microscopy, product temperature and pressure data
target_product: porous freeze-dried cake or milled powder
energy_model: freezing + shelf heating + sublimation + vacuum + condenser + refrigeration
equipment_scope: freezer/shelves, vacuum chamber, condenser, vacuum pumps, refrigeration, controls
cost_policy: vendor quotation or validated equipment curve only
proxy_policy: pharmaceutical equations permitted; numerical formulation parameters remain proxy/missing
milk_powder_policy: not relevant as direct cycle data
pharmaceutical_protein_policy: equations transferable, numerical collapse/stability constants not transferable
required_direct_inputs: nucleation/freezing, collapse temperature, cake resistance, product temperature, residual moisture, stability, energy and cycle time
validation_targets: product below collapse limit; primary-drying endpoint; residual moisture and quality retention
data_completeness: high for model structure, low for grass-specific parameters
warnings: Freeze drying may preserve some properties but is not automatically superior and may cause interface, freezing or over-drying damage.
